## Ejercicio

<div style="margin-top: 10px;">

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1" style="background: #a78bfa; color: white; font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
<strong>1.</strong> Si $A \subset B$, entonces $A \cap B = A$. <span class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="6" style="float: right; font-weight: bold;">✓ Verdadero</span>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2" style="background: #3b82f6; color: white; font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
<strong>2.</strong> El evento vacío $\emptyset$ es imposible, por lo que no pertenece a $\Omega$. <span class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="7" style="float: right; font-weight: bold;">✗ Falso ($\emptyset \subset \Omega$)</span>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="3" style="background: #59A14F; color: white; font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
<strong>3.</strong> Para cualquier evento $A$: $(A^c)^c = A$. <span class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="8" style="float: right; font-weight: bold;">✓ Verdadero</span>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="4" style="background: #F28E2B; color: white; font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
<strong>4.</strong> Si $A \cap B = \emptyset$, entonces $A$ y $B$ son complementarios. <span class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="9" style="float: right; font-weight: bold;">✗ Falso (falta $A \cup B = \Omega$)</span>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="5" style="background: #B07AA1; color: white; font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;">
<strong>5.</strong> $(A \cup B)^c = A^c \cap B^c$ es la primera Ley de De Morgan. <span class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="10" style="float: right; font-weight: bold;">✓ Verdadero</span>
</div>

</div>
